name: reelier
description: Record an agent's tool-call workflow once, replay it deterministically at 0 tokens, and diff runs to catch drift — CI + snapshot tests for MCP tool-call workflows.
long_description: Reelier records an agent's tool-call session (MCP-native), compiles it into a SKILL.md with an assertion on every step, replays it at Level 0 (no LLM, milliseconds, byte-identical, read-only by default), and diffs runs to report SAME or DRIFTED per step with exit 1 on drift. Every run writes a receipt. AGPL-3.0, local-first, BYOK.

tools.name: reelier_scan
tools.description: Scan agent session history for replayable tool-call workflows

tools.name: reelier_from_session
tools.description: Compile a recorded session into a replayable SKILL.md

tools.name: reelier_replay
tools.description: Replay a skill deterministically at 0 tokens with per-step assertions

tools.name: reelier_diff
tools.description: Diff two runs of a skill — SAME or DRIFTED per step, exit 1 on drift

tools.name: reelier_push
tools.description: Sync a run receipt to the reelier.com ledger for a shareable permalink (opt-in)
